title: Governed remote branch clutter retirement with immutable snapshot preservation in susi-harness and push-policy
goal: Implement susi-harness retire-branches (retire_remote_clutter) and native push-policy preservation checks so non-main remote refs/heads/* clutter (including merged and RETIRE-ledger local-agent/* branches when --include-local-agent is set) is preserved as immutable refs/tags/susi-distill/legacy-* tags confirmed on origin before compare-and-swap deletion, while unconditionally protecting refs/heads/main, active claims, and unmerged active agent branches.
